nameAndMeaning.title: Name and Meaning
nameAndMeaning.content: Seisan (十三) simply means "thirteen". The Japanese kanji are 十 (10) and 三 (3). This is usually interpreted as "13 (killed?) techniques" or "13 combat movements". An alternative explanation is "10 and 3" where most techniques in the kata are repeated three times. Since the kanji (seishan) already existed before karate in Japan, it is uncertain whether the Okinawan original had a different meaning. The fact is that 13 is considered a lucky number in China, which some find relevant symbolism.
